name: CRntFile_Allocate
reason: allocates the file's block of the given size and puts the position at 0; false when no allocator can be had

name: CRntFile_Seek
reason: moves the read/write position: whence 0 sets it, 1 adds to it, 2 puts it on the last byte; false when the target is outside the contents

name: CRntFile_Write
reason: writes bytes at the position, growing the file, and moves the position on

name: CRntFile_WriteElements
reason: writes count elements of a size at the position, growing the file, and returns the bytes written

name: CRntFile_Fill
reason: writes size bytes of a value at the position (memset), growing the file

name: CRntFile_Reserve
reason: makes room for count elements of a size at the position, allocating or growing the block

name: CRntFile_Read
reason: reads count elements of a size from the position, swapping each element's bytes when the swap flag is set

name: CRntFile_WriteFormat
reason: the formatted write, the counterpart of the formatted read

name: CRntFile_ReadCString
reason: points the output at the string at the position and moves past its terminator (at most 0x200 bytes)

name: CRntFile_ReadFormat
reason: the formatted read: each format character reads one value of its type into the next argument, from the file's start

name: CRntFile_CopyAssign
reason: copy assignment of a file held in memory

name: AddReflectedField
reason: registers a member field of a class descriptor by name, type and offset, and returns its description

name: AddReflectedFunction
reason: adds a function of the given name to a class descriptor and returns its description; null if the class already has one by that name

name: TypeAttributes
reason: returns a type's attribute container (CType+0x80), creating it on first use

name: XParasiteAI_Reset
reason: runs the base's reset, then puts every member of the component back to its starting value

name: XParasiteAI_PickWeightedChoice
reason: picks one of four choices at random by the weights at +0x14728 and their mask

name: XParasiteAI_SetEffectActive
reason: starts (on) or stops (off) the effect of the current binding on the owner

name: XParasiteAI_FleeFromTarget
reason: stores under v3FleePos a point far behind the owner as seen from its target

name: XParasiteAI_ApplyBehavior
reason: copies a behaviour object's flag and four weights into the component and dispatches on its kind

name: XParasiteAI_SetCanBeAbsorbed
reason: sets the flag at +0x146e8 and stores it under the blackboard property the unit's static initialiser names bCanBeAbsorbed

name: XParasiteAI_SetPrey
reason: points the weak handle at +0x14798 (the prey) at the given object and takes the prey's value

name: XParasiteAI_AttractToPowerBomb
reason: stores true under bIsBeingAttracted and the given position under v3PowerBombPos (property names from the unit's static initialiser)

name: XParasiteAI_FindFarthestEntry
reason: returns a counted reference to the usable entry whose actor is farthest from the owner's target
